title: 统一翻译调度问题模型
description: 梳理批量、单图、V2 与非 V2 的翻译调度入口，抽出共享的 endpoint 选择、重试预算与运行态边界。禁止继续在分叉路径上追加一次性补丁。
acceptance_criteria: 批量入口、单图入口、V2 批处理、非 V2 批处理都通过同一套共享调度辅助逻辑读取 endpoint 可用性、重试预算和 runId；代码中不存在第二套平行的 retry/failover 状态定义；从 hooks/useProcessor.ts 的 3 个入口能追到同一共享实现。
review_initial_requirements: Review 共享抽象边界是否清晰，确认没有新增隐式全局状态；保留 runId、防串写与 endpoint runtime 一致性。
review_regression_requirements: 回归批量启动、单图启动、端点暂停后恢复三类基础链路，确认状态迁移一致且无死循环。
notes: picked_reason:phase 1 shared scheduling refactor unblocks later P1 failover and single-image issues;done_at:2026-03-08;evidence:npm run build passed;evidence:shared helpers now drive retry budget, endpoint availability snapshot, and translate run lifecycle;validation_limited:no automated useProcessor scheduling regression harness and no browser UI session in CLI;manual_test:npm run dev then verify single-image start, batch start, and paused-endpoint alert paths reuse shared scheduling helpers;risk:medium translate scheduling refactor validated by build/static review only;blocked:git commit failed cmd quoting for non-ASCII message;git_retry:resolved direct git invocation after cmd quoting failure

title: 失败图片进入共享 failover 重试
description: 把 endpoint 保护与图片 retry 解耦，任何失败都先回到共享 failover 流程，再从当前可用 endpoint 集合重新选路。图片终止条件只能是预算耗尽或无可用 endpoint。
acceptance_criteria: 至少覆盖 429、503、网络失败、解析失败 4 类失败注入；protectable 与 non-protectable 失败都不会直接让图片终止；仅当重试预算耗尽或无可用 endpoint 时图片状态才落为 error；同一图片记录已尝试 endpoint/attempt，避免坏端点死循环；V2 与非 V2 批处理都能将失败图片重新排队。
review_initial_requirements: Review endpoint pause/disable 仍即时生效，但不再阻断图片换端点；检查 request/batch 分支对 retry budget、失败分类与日志字段的使用一致。
review_regression_requirements: 复测多 endpoint 场景下的失败切换、端点池收缩、全部端点不可用 3 组回归，确认无重复入队、无限循环或错误成功。
notes: picked_reason:phase 2 builds directly on shared scheduling helpers from RPT-000;done_at:2026-03-08;evidence:npm run build passed;evidence:V2 and non-V2 batch paths now force per-request maxRetries=0 and requeue failures through shared scheduleFailoverRetry;validation_limited:no automated hook-level failure injection harness for 429/503/network/parse batch failover in CLI;manual_test:npm run dev then batch-translate across multiple endpoints and inject 429 503 network and parse failures to confirm requeue until budget exhausted or no available endpoint;risk:medium shared batch failover semantics changed without live browser regression session

title: 单图翻译复用批量 failover 逻辑
description: 移除 onlyCurrent 路径只拿第一个 endpoint 的特例，让单图与批量共用 endpoint 选择、故障切换与收尾语义。
acceptance_criteria: 单图翻译不再固定只调用首个 enabled endpoint；首个 endpoint 失败后可在预算内切换至少 1 个其他可用 endpoint；无可用 endpoint 时返回明确失败并收尾到 idle/error 终态，不残留 processing。
review_initial_requirements: Review onlyCurrent 路径是否真正复用共享调度逻辑，而不是复制批处理代码；确认取消、endpoint controller 注册/反注册与用户提示完整。
review_regression_requirements: 复测单图连续失败、用户手动取消、中途 endpoint pause/disable 3 类场景，确认行为与批量模式一致。
notes: picked_reason:onlyCurrent can now reuse the shared batch failover path instead of diverging again;done_at:2026-03-08;evidence:npm run build passed;evidence:onlyCurrent now delegates directly to processQueue so single-image translate reuses batch endpoint selection and failover cleanup;validation_limited:no browser session in CLI to live-drive single-image cancel/pause-disable scenarios;manual_test:npm run dev then run single-image translate with multiple endpoints, force first endpoint failure, verify failover, cancel cleanup, and pause-disable behavior match batch mode;risk:medium-low single-image path now reuses already-built batch scheduler instead of maintaining its own branch

title: 修复 abort 收尾与残留 processing 清理
description: 确保 abort、endpoint_trip、endpoint_disabled 后的 cleanup 不再被 signal.aborted 吞掉，并在批处理结束时兜底清理残留 processing 状态。
acceptance_criteria: abort、endpoint_trip、endpoint_disabled 后，相关图片在一次任务收尾内能从 processing 回到 idle 或明确终态；批处理完成后 status=processing 的图片数为 0；runId 防串写仍生效；被清理的图片可再次进入后续处理队列。
review_initial_requirements: Review canWriteForRun/setImagesIfActive 的调整仅放宽 abort cleanup，不放宽普通过期写入；保留 runId 防止旧任务覆盖新任务。
review_regression_requirements: 复测用户取消、endpoint_trip、endpoint_disabled、任务中途重启 4 类场景，确认图库蓝色转圈消失且图片后续可重试。
notes: picked_reason:cleanup bug sits in the same useProcessor execution path and blocks reliable retries;done_at:2026-03-08;evidence:npm run build passed;evidence:abort cleanup writes now explicitly allow aborted signals while still honoring active runId, and processQueue finally clears residual translate processing states;validation_limited:no browser session in CLI to exercise cancel endpoint_trip endpoint_disabled and restart scenarios end-to-end;manual_test:npm run dev then start batch translate, trigger user cancel, endpoint_trip, endpoint_disabled, and immediate restart to confirm spinners clear and images return to retryable states;risk:medium cleanup semantics changed around aborted signal handling but stale-run guard remains runId-gated

title: 统一 skipped 的硬语义与导出边界
description: 在单图与批量 API 入口都拦截 skipped，并保证下载、ZIP、合并图层对 skipped 始终导出原图。skip 语义必须独立于临时 UI 开关。
acceptance_criteria: skipped 图片不能进入单图或批量翻译请求；单图下载、ZIP、批量选中导出、合并图层 4 条链路均保留原图；混合选择 skipped 与非 skipped 图片时，只有 skipped 保留原图且非 skipped 输出不受影响。
review_initial_requirements: Review skip 语义在入口过滤、导出分发与合并图层链路上保持一致；不要影响非 skipped 图片的既有导出结果。
review_regression_requirements: 复测单图、批量、ZIP、合并图层、混合选择、重置状态后再导出等边界，确认 skip 与非 skip 的行为稳定可复现。
notes: picked_reason:skip entry and export semantics must be aligned before config/UI migration in RPT-050;done_at:2026-03-08;evidence:npm run build passed;evidence:single-image translate now blocks skipped items and compositeDispatch always exports skipped images from the untouched original source, covering single download ZIP batch export and merge-layers callers;validation_limited:no browser session in CLI to manually verify all single batch ZIP and merge-layer skip combinations;manual_test:npm run dev then mark images skipped and verify single translate button blocks, single download ZIP selected export and merge-layers preserve original only for skipped images in mixed selections;risk:medium skip export semantics changed globally via compositeDispatch but non-skipped images still flow through existing renderer paths

title: 明确 exportSkippedAsOriginal 迁移与 UI 文案
description: 决定 exportSkippedAsOriginal 是迁移为固定行为还是保留兼容开关，并同步默认值、设置页与用户提示，避免行为变化被误读。
acceptance_criteria: 默认值、设置页、帮助文案与实际行为 3 处一致；若保留兼容开关，必须明确并实现其被强制开启或失效的条件；刷新页面或重新载入配置后，展示状态与实际导出行为一致。
review_initial_requirements: Review 配置迁移对旧项目/本地存储的兼容性，避免无提示行为突变；文案、默认值与实际逻辑必须同一提交落地。
review_regression_requirements: 验证新旧配置加载、切换语言、刷新页面后的设置展示与 skip 导出行为一致，不出现 UI 说法和真实逻辑冲突。
notes: picked_reason:skip behavior is now fixed in code and the persisted config/UI must stop lying about it;done_at:2026-03-08;evidence:npm run build passed;evidence:default config storage migration export callers and settings copy now all reflect always-on skipped-original behavior;validation_limited:node --experimental-strip-types services/aiConfigStorage.test.ts could not run because extensionless ESM imports are unresolved in the current ad-hoc CLI runner;manual_test:npm run dev then load an old config with exportSkippedAsOriginal=false, refresh, switch language, and confirm the settings card stays checked+disabled while skipped exports still keep originals;risk:medium-low migration forces a single persisted value and only changes a now-obsolete compatibility flag

title: 补齐 failover、cleanup、skip 语义回归测试
description: 围绕多 endpoint failover、abort cleanup、skip 入口与导出三组高风险行为建立回归用例，防止后续重构回退。
acceptance_criteria: 至少新增或补齐 3 组回归场景：多 endpoint failover、abort/endpoint_trip/endpoint_disabled cleanup、skipped 入口与导出语义；每组至少包含 1 个失败或边界用例；测试能在本地重复运行并稳定通过。
review_initial_requirements: Review 用例不要只覆盖 happy path，必须覆盖失败注入、队列回收、混合选择与边界输入；测试命名能直接指向语义合同。
review_regression_requirements: 执行新增回归测试后，人工 spot-check 至少 1 条真实 UI 链路，确认测试结论与界面表现一致。

title: 完成构建与针对性回归验收
description: 在修复完成后执行构建与关键流程验证，确认翻译流程、图库状态、下载导出和设置项没有新增回归，并整理可追溯的变更说明。
acceptance_criteria: vite build 通过；完成单图翻译、批量翻译、abort cleanup、skip 导出、设置项展示至少 5 条验证记录；变更说明能逐项对照 issue id 或 phase，便于会议复盘。
review_initial_requirements: Review 验证步骤是否可复现，并记录失败输入、期望输出与观察结果；不要只报告“已测通过”而无场景清单。
review_regression_requirements: 做一次全链路复测：初始配置、变更配置、刷新恢复、混合图片状态；确认无新增 blocking 问题后再进入提交。
